name: io.github.ayush00dhyani-star/toolproof
title: Toolproof
description: Trust grades for MCP servers and APIs: scan the model-visible surface (tool names, descriptions, schemas, prompts, resources, server instructions, outbound hosts) for hidden instructions, invisible unicode, exposed secrets and unsafe defaults, and return a letter grade with an ed25519-signed verdict that verifies offline. Also exposes a policy gate that fails CI when a tool's capability surface drifts.
